title: The return of COCO JUNGLE
description: Stout for those who missed the warm time and travel is back in stock

blocks.html:
Coco Jungle is a rich coconut milk stout. Aging on coconut shavings lasts more than 20 days, and for the fullness of taste and perfect balance, we added lactose to the caramel malts. The stout turned out to be very soft, with a bright aroma, a pronounced taste of coconut and a perfect balance between creamy sweetness and bitter notes of burnt bread. In the aftertaste there are notes of an exotic dessert and, despite the strength of 6.8%, it is drunk very easily, like a cup of mocha at the airport before a flight to warm countries. The final sip will be long-lasting and enveloping, like a piece of bitter chocolate, carefully offered by the flight attendant. This is the long-awaited journey that you deserve!

ABV 6,8% IBU 15
Available in 20 l kegs and 0.5 l bottles — Order.
